007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.agent;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.SelectAIAgent;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.Task;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.TaskAttributes;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.TaskStatus;
013import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
014import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
015
016import java.util.Arrays;
017import java.util.List;
018
019/** Sample for creating a DBMS_CLOUD_AI_AGENT task. */
020public final class CreateTaskSample {
021
022    private CreateTaskSample() {
023    }
024
025    /**
026     * Runs the sample and propagates failures to the command-line caller.
027     *
028     * @param args command-line arguments; not used
029     * @throws SelectAIException when an SDK operation fails
030     */
031    public static void main(String[] args) throws SelectAIException {
032        String taskName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_TASK_NAME");
033        try (SelectAIAgent selectAIAgent = createSelectAIAgent()) {
034            TaskAttributes attributes = TaskAttributes.builder()
035                    .instruction(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_TASK_INSTRUCTION"))
036                    .tools(optionalList("SELECTAI_AGENT_TASK_TOOLS"))
037                    .input(optionalList("SELECTAI_AGENT_TASK_INPUT"))
038                    .enableHumanTool(optionalBoolean("SELECTAI_AGENT_TASK_ENABLE_HUMAN_TOOL"))
039                    .build();
040            Task task = selectAIAgent.task(taskName, attributes,
041                    env("SELECTAI_AGENT_TASK_DESCRIPTION"), status("SELECTAI_AGENT_TASK_STATUS"));
042
043            boolean created = task.create();
044            System.out.printf("Create task '%s' completed: %s%n", task.getTaskName(), created);
045        }
046    }
047
048    private static SelectAIAgent createSelectAIAgent() throws SelectAIException {
049        return SelectAIAgent.create(DbConnectionConfig.builder()
050                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
051                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
052                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
053                .build());
054    }
055
056    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
057        String value = System.getenv(name);
058        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
059            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
060        }
061        return value;
062    }
063
064    private static String env(String name) {
065        String value = System.getenv(name);
066        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? null : value;
067    }
068
069    private static List<String> optionalList(String name) {
070        String value = env(name);
071        return value == null ? null : Arrays.stream(value.split(","))
072                .map(String::trim)
073                .filter(item -> !item.isEmpty())
074                .toList();
075    }
076
077    private static Boolean optionalBoolean(String name) {
078        String value = env(name);
079        return value == null ? null : Boolean.valueOf(value);
080    }
081
082    private static TaskStatus status(String name) {
083        String value = env(name);
084        return value == null ? null : TaskStatus.fromValue(value);
085    }
086}
